data.body_html:
Planning a vegan catering yacht charter in Marbella 2032? You’re in luck. Our fleet from Puerto Banús offers plant-based menus that match the Mediterranean lifestyle. Whether you’re cruising to Cabopino or anchoring near Estepona, we ensure every meal is fresh, local, and completely vegan. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats, including skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Read on for everything you need to know about vegan options on your Marbella yacht charter.

Why Choose a Vegan Yacht Charter in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline is perfect for a sustainable, plant-based charter. With warm waters and scenic spots like Cala del Faro, vegan catering aligns with the eco-conscious travel trend. Our charters include vegan-friendly drinks like cava and white wine, plus light snacks such as olives, nuts, and fruit. All packages come with a licensed skipper, insurance, and 21% VAT included. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a free jet ski and starts from €4,719 for 4 hours.

Our Fleet and Vegan Catering Options

Every boat in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. Here’s a quick overview of popular choices:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, ideal for small vegan groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, great for friends or family.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h, includes jet ski and ample space.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – pricing on request, perfect for luxury vegan charters.

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Vegan alternatives can be arranged, such as vegetable platters, hummus, and plant-based wines. For larger yachts like the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax), we offer customized vegan menus upon request.

Local Vegan Sourcing in Marbella

We source ingredients from local Marbella suppliers, ensuring freshness and sustainability. Think Andalusian olive oil, ripe tomatoes from the Costa del Sol, and seasonal fruits. Our vegan menus reflect the region’s bounty, from gazpacho to grilled vegetables. This commitment to local sourcing enhances your Marbella yacht charter experience, making it both ethical and delicious.

Sample Vegan Menu for Your Charter

Here’s what a typical vegan menu might include:

  • Starters: Hummus with pita, marinated olives, and fresh vegetable crudités.
  • Main: Grilled vegetable skewers with quinoa salad or a vegan paella.
  • Dessert: Fresh fruit platter or vegan chocolate mousse.
  • Drinks: Vegan-friendly cava, white wine, and soft drinks.

Menus can be tailored to your preferences. Just let us know via WhatsApp when booking.

Dietary Restrictions Beyond Vegan

We accommodate other dietary needs too, including gluten-free, nut-free, and halal options. Our team works with local caterers to ensure every guest is satisfied. For example, the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) is a cozy option for a small group with specific dietary requirements. Contact us to discuss your needs.

Booking Your Vegan Yacht Charter

Ready to book your vegan catering yacht charter in Marbella 2032? Simply choose your boat and contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and menu customization. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, with itineraries to Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande. Prices for Tier A boats start at €749/2h, while Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719/4h. We recommend booking early, especially for 2032, as vegan charters are increasingly popular.
